units.title: SG-4.1.4 Unit test asserts phaser resolves to 3.90.x

tests.name: phaserPinHelper.test.ts > phaserPinProblems > returns no problems for 3.90.x
tests.title: phaserPinProblems returns no problems for 3.90.x
tests.scenario: Given package.json and lockfile pin phaser ~3.90.0 with installed 3.90.0, when the guard inspects them, then no problems are reported

tests.name: phaserPinHelper.test.ts > phaserPinProblems > reports 4.x in the package.json field
tests.title: phaserPinProblems reports 4.x in the package.json field
tests.scenario: Given package.json has ^4.2.1 and the lockfile is 3.90.x, when the guard inspects them, then a problem names package.json

tests.id: reports 4.x in the lockfile root specifier field
tests.name: phaserPinHelper.test.ts > phaserPinProblems > reports 4.x in the lockfile root specifier field
tests.title: phaserPinProblems reports 4.x in the lockfile root specifier field
tests.scenario: Given the lockfile root specifier is ^4.2.1 and package.json is 3.90.x, when the guard inspects them, then a problem names the lockfile root

tests.id: reports 4.x in the node_modules/phaser version field
tests.name: phaserPinHelper.test.ts > phaserPinProblems > reports 4.x in the node_modules/phaser version field
tests.title: phaserPinProblems reports 4.x in the node_modules/phaser version field
tests.scenario: Given the installed node_modules/phaser version is 4.2.1 and specifiers are 3.90.x, when the guard inspects them, then a problem names node_modules/phaser

tests.id: reports a problem when the node_modules/phaser entry is missing
tests.name: phaserPinHelper.test.ts > phaserPinProblems > reports a problem when the node_modules/phaser entry is missing
tests.title: phaserPinProblems reports a problem when the node_modules/phaser entry is missing
tests.scenario: Given the lockfile has no node_modules/phaser entry, when the guard inspects them, then at least one problem is reported

units.title: Verify: phaser version guard reads real package.json and lockfile

tests.id: phaserVersionGuard.test.ts > phaser version guard > reports no pin problems for the real package.json and package-lock.json
tests.name: phaser version guard reports no pin problems for the real package.json and package-lock.json
tests.title: reports no pin problems for the real package.json and package-lock.json
tests.scenario: Given the real frontend package.json and package-lock.json on disk, when the phaser pin guard inspects them, then it reports no problems.

tests.id: phaserVersionGuard.test.ts > phaser version guard > keeps the lockfile root specifier equal to package.json and the installed phaser on 3.90.x
tests.name: phaser version guard keeps the lockfile root specifier equal to package.json and the installed phaser on 3.90.x
tests.title: keeps the lockfile root specifier equal to package.json and the installed phaser on 3.90.x
tests.scenario: Given the real package.json and package-lock.json, when the phaser specifiers and the node_modules/phaser version are read, then the lockfile root specifier equals package.json and the installed version is 3.90.x, not 4.x.
tests.detail: Step 2: root specifier equals package.json (~3.90.0); node_modules/phaser is 3.90.0, matches /^3\.90\.\d+$/ and not /^4\./.
